import pytest

from parse_int import parse_int


def test_parse_int():
    assert parse_int([49, 50, 51]) == 123
    assert parse_int([45, 55]) == -7
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_int([])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_int([45])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_int([49, 120])
